messages:
michael: Quick follow-up from the 3/15 postmortem. Postmortem is merged but we still have open items: (1) make triage steps copy-pasteable in the runbook, (2) eliminate ambiguity in the escalation path, (3) assign owners + clear deadlines for remediation tasks, (4) add a lightweight recurring canary to surface the eviction ramp early. Who can pick these up?

tara: I can take (1) and include exact commands and a short "how-to-validate" checklist that someone oncall can run during a drill. Will add kubectl and PromQL snippets.

oncall-ops: Ill take (2) escalation path. We had confusion about paging infra vs platform during the outage. Ill add a one-page emergency script and a strict timeout-based ruleset (2m page ack -> autodial).

tara: Planned triage snippets to add to runbook:
```sh
# list pods with eviction events in last hour
kubectl get events --all-namespaces --field-selector reason=Evicted --since=1h -o json | jq '.items[] | {ns:.metadata.namespace, pod:.involvedObject.name, msg:.message}'
# eviction rate by pool (Prometheus)
curl -s "${PROM}/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (pool)" | jq .
# quick KV cache hitratio check
curl -s "${PROM}/api/v1/query?query=kv_cache_hitratio" | jq .
```

sophie: Ill take (3) owners + deadlines. I propose splitting remediation into: M1 (config/runbook fixes, 2w), M2 (canary + CI lint, 4w), M3 (platform fix, 8w). Ill assign owners and publish dates in the tracking ticket. Also suggest owner-ping cadence: 7/14/28 days.

eng-bot: Created INF-7001: "Runbook + escalation playbook edits from 3/15 postmortem" assigned to tara,oncall-ops,sophie. Due 2025-04-11. Linked INF-7001 -> INF-7002 (canary probe) and INF-7003 (runbook-lint CI).

pm-ops: Ill review for customer-facing items and prepare a short comms blurb template if we need to notify customers. Please tag anything with potential external impact.

oncall-ops: Canary probe I plan to add to the dedicated pool (low blast radius):
```yaml
readinessProbe:
  exec:
    command: ["/bin/sh","-c","curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health || exit 2"]
  periodSeconds: 30
  failureThreshold: 3
```
This should trigger an alert before eviction ramps across the pool.

tara: ETA for runbook PR with commands + drill checklist: EOD tomorrow. Ill include copy-paste snippets and a small validation section.

sophie: Ill create the remediation breakdown in INF-7001 today and publish owners/dates. Will also add the owner reminder workflow (eng-bot ping at 7/14 days).

pm-ops: Ill flag any customer-visible items within 48h. If none, we keep internal comms.

michael: Recap: tara -> triage PR by EOD tomorrow; oncall-ops -> escalation + autodial rule in 3 days; sophie -> remediation owners+dates today; eng-bot -> tickets created and reminders. Schedule a 2-week verification drill after PRs land to exercise the canary and run the checklist.

eng-bot: Scheduled follow-up reminder for INF-7001 on 2025-04-25.

michael: Thanks all. Once PRs are merged well close INF-7001 and update the runbook index. If anyone needs pairing help writing PromQL or the canary YAML ping me.
